title: ULTRA milestone — expected end-state for the agency-site brief (M1-M8 outcome assertions)
_comment: WP-Q07 expected outcomes. Read DIRECTLY by e2e-agency-site.contract.ts (NOT the generic fixture-loader). Each `metrics.M*` block encodes the contract-accurate end-state the scenario must observe AFTER running brief.agency-site.json over the live MCP/REST surface (00-product-overview.md §6 M1-M8). Values that are install-minted at runtime (post ids, regenerated local-style ids, watermark counters) are NOT pinned here — the assertions are STRUCTURAL (selector rules present, conditions slash-strings equal, modified_labels non-empty, results map shape) exactly like the WP-Q06 render assertion re-reads the saved id. M3/M4/M7 are NOT Q07's gates (HTML coverage / drift / visual-fidelity live in their own suites); they are listed as `out_of_scope` so the M-coverage map stays complete.

M1.name: Build-a-hero-renders-styled
M1._comment: Reuse the WP-Q06 render assertion: the hero page is created, the atomic tree saved with prime_css, and the public per-breakpoint CSS contains the local + global class selector rules. Re-derives the styled ids from the saved tree ([R5] — the local id is regenerated on save; assert the GLOBAL stable rule over HTTP and treat the local rule as confirmed when present / prime confirmed [S01]).

M2.name: Safe-edit-with-rollback
M2._comment: Edit produces a structured diff + passes authoritative dry_run; rollback restores the prior tree AND re-primes CSS. Asserted structurally: the diff is non-empty before commit, the post-rollback structure equals the pre-edit structure (compare by element ids/structure, not literal minted ids), and prime_css ran on rollback.

M5.name: Design-system safety
M5._comment: classes.upsert uses the diff-PUT (full order, explicit changes.deleted), pre-flights the 1000-item budget, and reconciles DUPLICATED_LABEL soft errors. Asserted: the PUT returned ok with a consistent final order; a budget pre-flight ran (count(existing)−deleted+added ≤ 1000); the seeded duplicate-label class produced a non-empty modified_labels soft outcome (a 200, not an error) the caller can rebind.

M6.name: Capability-aware operation
M6._comment: The server probes site/capabilities before assuming any route. On atomic-off: design-system tools hard-fail with actionable messages (can_update_class=false / experiment inactive) and atomic builds fall back to V3 — never a crash. On no-Pro: the theme + popup steps SKIP cleanly with an actionable message. The Pro/atomic legs are gated so the SAME corpus runs on free-only and Pro installs (mirrors the fixture-loader requires gate).

M8.name: Cross-doc transaction integrity
M8._comment: batch.apply records backups of the kit + every touched doc UP FRONT and best-effort compensates on partial failure, returning a per-step result map. Asserted via the forced-partial-failure plan: backups_required (from batch.plan) enumerates the kit + touched docs BEFORE any mutation; step 0 ok:true, step 1 ok:false with error code E_ATOMIC_VALIDATION; compensated:true (step 0 was rolled back). A separate forced-compensation-failure variant asserts E_COMPENSATION_FAILED surfaces (HTTP 500) when the compensation itself fails (maps to INTERNAL_ERROR with meta.phase='compensation' in the TS taxonomy, since COMPENSATION_FAILED is not in the §6 enum).

out_of_scope._comment: These M-metrics are proven by other QA suites, not Q07 — listed so the M-coverage map is complete.
out_of_scope.M4: Validator fidelity / schema drift — WP-Q02 schema-drift.test.ts + dry-run-roundtrip.contract.ts

teardown._comment: The scenario is idempotent (re-runnable) and trashes ALL created artifacts + reverts kit changes in teardown.
